operations.feature: read EPUB, PDF, MOBI and other ebook formats
operations.goal: Open and read an ebook in Readest. Steps: 1) In the Readest library window, find and click the button to add/import/open a book (such as Add, Import, Open, or +). 2) When the file chooser appears, navigate to /Users/sbx/pickfit-in and open testbook.txt. 3) Open the book if needed and show its content on screen. The book contains the unique word Zephyrmantle.

operations.feature: search full text inside books and library
operations.goal: Search full text inside the book in Readest. Steps: 1) In the library open the book testbook (in /Users/sbx/pickfit-in/testbook.txt, import it via Import Books > From Local File if not already in library). 2) Once the book is open, find and use the Search function (magnifying glass icon or search in the reader toolbar/menu). 3) Type Zephyrmantle in the search box and run the search. 4) Show the search results highlighting the matching section. The book contains the word Zephyrmantle.
operations.observed: on screen (read by the screen judge, muse-spark-1.3, from pickfit's last screenshot): "Zephyrmantle": yes

operations.goal: Add a highlight and note in the book in Readest. Steps: 1) Open the book testbook in the library (import from /Users/sbx/pickfit-in/testbook.txt via Import Books > From Local File if needed). 2) Select the sentence containing Zephyrmantle by dragging over it. 3) From the popup menu choose Highlight and add a note if offered. 4) Open the annotations/notes/highlights panel to show the saved highlight containing Zephyrmantle on screen.

operations.goal: Use text-to-speech narration in Readest. Steps: 1) Open the book testbook in the library (import from /Users/sbx/pickfit-in/testbook.txt via Import Books > From Local File if needed, the book contains Zephyrmantle). 2) Find and click the Speak / Read Aloud / TTS button in the reader toolbar (headphone or speaker icon). 3) Start playback if needed and show the narration player bar with the book text Zephyrmantle visible on screen.

findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: Peer minimum ACK delay can panic quinn-proto when ACK_FREQUENCY transmission is enabled

evidence: the project's source does not use ACK_FREQUENCY, but other packages depend on quinn-proto

findings.summary: Outgoing datagram buffer accounting can panic the sender in quinn-proto
zip: Unbounded Symlink-Target Handling Can Abort Or Exhaust Memory During Extraction
Insecure Preservation of SUID/SGID Bits during ZIP Extraction Leading to Potential Privilege Escalation
